message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to the incoming data or command-line arguments beyond argparse's basic type coercion.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is downloaded via torchvision.datasets.CIFAR10 with download=True but no checksum verification, signed URL, or pinned revision is used to authenticate or verify integrity of the downloaded data.
No detected label flipping detection: No code validates label values against an expected set, compares label distributions for anomalies, or uses any label-noise detection tool like Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation code only performs class-ratio resampling and standard augmentation transforms; there is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious inputs.
No detected model integrity verification: The trainer.load_model() call loads model weights but no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision is performed anywhere in the visible code.

No detected label distribution validation: The code uses imbalance ratios to artificially create class imbalance and employs ImbalancedDatasetSampler, but there is no explicit validation or assertion checking that label distributions match expected values before training begins.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no backdoor or trigger detection mechanism such as neural cleanse, activation clustering, or gradient anomaly analysis anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard AdamW optimizers with no differential privacy library (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanism applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the evaluation pipeline.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path (trainer.test via test_loader) passes batches directly from the DataLoader to the model without any shape, range, or schema validation checks.

No detected output bounds checks: The code uses classification_report for evaluation metrics but performs no sanity checks on model outputs such as NaN guards, probability bounds, or calibrated threshold validation before returning predictions.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is an image classification pipeline (CIFAR-10), not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
